info.title: AdoRead.WorkItems.Cli
info.description: Read-only Azure DevOps work items, comments and images as agent-friendly JSON.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Read one Azure DevOps work item and all of its comments.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --compact
options.description: Emit compact JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.

options.name: --download-images
options.description: Download supported work-item images to an empty directory. Needs the images privacy category.

options.name: --privacy
options.description: Tighten this call to a level: minimal, standard or full. It can never loosen the stored policy.

options.name: --withhold
options.description: Withhold one category for this call: text, comments, people, customFields, images, testMessages, stackTraces or logs. Repeatable.

arguments.name: ID_OR_URL
arguments.description: Positive work-item ID or Azure DevOps work-item URL.

options.name: --organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization URL.

options.name: --config
options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace an existing configuration file. [default: False]

options.name: --project
options.description: Default project for the sprint and wiki commands. Discover one with 'ado-read-work-item projects'.

options.name: --team
options.description: Default team for the sprint commands. Discover one with 'ado-read-work-item teams'.

options.name: --config
options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Store, check or remove the token of an organization in the OS credential vault.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Store a personal access token for an organization. The token is typed at a masked prompt, never passed as an argument.

options.name: --organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization URL. Defaults to the organization in the configuration.

options.name: --config
options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report whether a token is stored for an organization, and in which vault.

options.name: --organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization URL. Defaults to the organization in the configuration.

options.name: --config
options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Remove the token stored for an organization from the OS credential vault.

options.name: --organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization URL. Defaults to the organization in the configuration.

options.name: --config
options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.

commands.name: privacy
commands.description: Show, set or reset which content categories AI agents may receive, per organization. Only a person can loosen the policy.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the privacy level and the effective allow or deny of each content category.

options.name: --organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization URL. Defaults to the organization in the configuration.

options.name: --config
options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set the privacy policy of an organization. Loosening needs an interactive terminal and a typed confirmation; tightening does not.

options.name: --organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization URL. Defaults to the organization in the configuration.

options.name: --config
options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.

options.name: --allow
options.description: Allow one category on top of the level: text, comments, people, customFields, images, testMessages, stackTraces or logs. Repeatable.

options.name: --deny
options.description: Deny one category on top of the level: text, comments, people, customFields, images, testMessages, stackTraces or logs. Repeatable.

arguments.name: LEVEL
arguments.description: minimal (metadata only), standard (metadata, text, comments, test messages and stack traces; people aliased) or full (everything). Case-insensitive.

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Remove the privacy policy of an organization. Afterwards no content is returned until a person runs privacy set.

options.name: --organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization URL. Defaults to the organization in the configuration.

options.description: Override the default ~/.ado-read/config.json path.
